BEFORE YOU CHOOSE

Get these numbers before choosing an incentive

Ask for quotes using the same home price, down payment, loan type and timing. Compare the builder's lender with another lender when practical.

  1. 01

    Cash to close

    Down payment, loan costs, prepaid items and escrow funding, minus deposits and usable credits. Ask which expenses the incentive can actually cover.

  2. 02

    Total monthly housing cost

    Principal and interest, mortgage insurance, taxes, homeowners insurance and HOA dues. HOA dues are usually paid separately from the mortgage.

  3. 03

    What changes later

    For any adjustable rate or temporary buydown, ask when the payment changes and what it could become. Confirm the rate-lock period and closing deadline.

  4. 04

    Home-specific written terms

    Confirm the address, incentive amount, allowed uses, combination rules, recurring dues, one-time HOA charges and expected completion date.
